definition: For this investigation only, a putative justification for excluding an action that does not derive its authority merely from an agent accepting a contingent permission plan or factual-to-prohibition conditional. This names the unfulfilled philosophical demand; no criterion of success or formal proposition asserting such warrant is supplied.
note: Contrast vocabulary used to delimit ConditionalGuidance. Not an attribution to Carneades or a commitment that cognitivism alone can meet this demand. It is deliberately not mapped to a Lean declaration; the proof establishes no categorical warrant. A defended account and source reading would be needed before formalizing one.
